content.text:
VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED

The logic is placed in the right units — the count lives in the service layer (`ClinicServiceImpl`) and the controller only performs the guard, matching the established pattern of `countOwnersByName` / `countOwnersByCity` and the existing guard clauses in `addOwner`. That part is coherent and additive.

The one idiomatic issue:

- **Use an import for `LocalDate` instead of the fully-qualified `java.time.LocalDate`.** The name appears fully-qualified inline in all three added spots: the interface (`ClinicService.java`), the impl signature (`ClinicServiceImpl.java:308`), and the controller (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:104`). Everywhere else in this codebase `LocalDate` is used via `import java.time.LocalDate;` (e.g. `Owner.java`, `Pet.java`, `Visit.java`). A maintainer here would expect the same: add `import java.time.LocalDate;` to each of the three files and use the simple name `LocalDate`, keeping the new code consistent with the surrounding style.
